Container.Name: pd_zurg
Container.Overview: Stream torrents directly to Plex/Emby/Jellyfin/Infuse through Debrid Services, using Plex Discover Watchlists, Trakt lists, and Overseerr. Leverages plex_debrid, zurg, and rclone combined in a single Docker image for faster deployment.

Config.Name: Path: /config
Config.Description: Required: Stores config files (settings.json, etc.). Create this folder if it doesn't exist.

Config.Name: Path: /log
Config.Description: Stores logs for troubleshooting. Create this folder if it doesn't exist.

Config.Name: Path: /cache
Config.Description: Optional: Cache for faster rclone operations (speeds up cloud access). Create this folder if you want to use caching.

Config.Name: Path: /data
Config.Description: Mount point for your Debrid cloud storage (e.g., RealDebrid). Make sure the 'nobody' user has read/write access.

Config.Name: Path: /zurg/RD
Config.Description: Location for Zurg RealDebrid active configuration.

Config.Name: AD_API_KEY
Config.Description: Your AllDebrid API Key.

Config.Name: AUTO_UPDATE_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Interval (in hours) for automatic updates (0 to disable).

Config.Name: CLEANUP_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Interval (in hours) for automatic cleanup of completed torrents by Zurg (0 to disable).

Config.Name: DUPLICATE_CLEANUP
Config.Description: Enable/disable automatic cleanup of duplicate torrents downloaded by Zurg (true/false).

Config.Name: GITHUB_TOKEN
Config.Description: GitHub Personal Token for use with Zurg private repo.

Config.Name: JF_API_KEY
Config.Description: Your Jellyfin API Key.

Config.Name: JF_ADDRESS
Config.Description: Your Jellyfin server address (e.g., http://your-server-ip:8096).

Config.Name: NFS_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable/disable NFS server for sharing the mounted RealDebrid folder.

Config.Name: NFS_PORT
Config.Description: Port for the NFS server (if enabled).

Config.Name: PDZURG_LOG_COUNT
Config.Description: Number of log files to keep for pd_zurg.

Config.Name: PDZURG_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log level for pd_zurg (INFO, DEBUG, etc.).

Config.Name: PDZURG_LOG_SIZE
Config.Description: Maximum size of the log file before it is rotated. Valid options are 'K' (kilobytes), 'M' (megabytes), and 'G' (gigabytes).

Config.Name: PD_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable/disable plex_debrid (true/false).

Config.Name: PD_LOGFILE
Config.Description: Enable/disable logging for plex_debrid (true/false).

Config.Name: PD_REPO
Config.Description: Repository to use for plex_debrid.

Config.Name: PLEX_ADDRESS
Config.Description: Your Plex server address (e.g., http://your-server-ip:32400).

Config.Name: PLEX_MOUNT_DIR
Config.Description: Mount directory for Plex (leave as is if unsure).

Config.Name: PLEX_REFRESH
Config.Description: Enable Plex library refresh after downloads (true/false).

Config.Name: PLEX_TOKEN
Config.Description: Your Plex token.

Config.Name: PLEX_USER
Config.Description: Your Plex username.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for the container to run as.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for the container to run as.

Config.Name: RCLONE_ALLOW_NON_EMPTY
Config.Description: Allow mounting non-empty directories with rclone (true/false).

Config.Name: RCLONE_ALLOW_OTHER
Config.Description: Allow other users to access the rclone mount (true/false).

Config.Name: RCLONE_ATTR_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Time to cache file attributes (e.g., '1h', '1d').

Config.Name: RCLONE_BUFFER_SIZE
Config.Description: Buffer size for rclone transfers (e.g., '1G', '2G').

Config.Name: RCLONE_DIR_CACHE_TIME
Config.Description: Time to cache directory listings (e.g., '1m', '5m').

Config.Name: RCLONE_LOG_FILE
Config.Description: Optional: Path to the rclone log file (leave blank for default).

Config.Name: RCLONE_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log level for rclone (NOTICE, INFO, DEBUG, etc.).

Config.Name: RCLONE_TRANSFERS
Config.Description: Number of concurrent transfers for rclone.

Config.Name: RCLONE_UMASK
Config.Description: Unix permissions mask for files created by rclone.

Config.Name: RCLONE_VFS_CACHE_MAX_AGE
Config.Description: Maximum age of objects in the cache.

Config.Name: RCLONE_VFS_READ_CHUNK_SIZE
Config.Description: Read chunk size for rclone.

Config.Name: RCLONE_VFS_READ_CHUNK_SIZE_LIMIT
Config.Description: Maximum chunk size limit for rclone reads.

Config.Name: SEERR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Your Overseerr/Jellyseerr API Key.

Config.Name: SEERR_ADDRESS
Config.Description: Your Overseerr/Jellyseerr address (e.g., http://your-server-ip:5055).

Config.Name: SHOW_MENU
Config.Description: Show the plex_debrid menu on startup (true/false).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for the container.

Config.Name: ZURG_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable/disable Zurg (true/false).

Config.Name: RD_API_KEY
Config.Description: Your RealDebrid API Key.

Config.Name: ZURG_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log level for Zurg (INFO, DEBUG, etc.).

Config.Name: ZURG_PORT
Config.Description: Port for the Zurg server.

Config.Name: ZURG_UPDATE
Config.Description: Enable automatic Zurg updates (true/false).

Config.Name: ZURG_USER
Config.Description: Username to protect the Zurg endpoints.

Config.Name: ZURG_VERSION
Config.Description: The version of Zurg to use (e.g., 'v0.9.x' or 'nightly').
